mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PREP_NOBID_ACK (EMP_NO, INSTITUTION_ID, ROUND_SEQ, NOTICE_HANDLED_AT, NOTICE_REV_NO, BID_CASE_ID, PREP_STATE_CD, EMP_VERIFIED, SCREEN_ID, BUTTON_ID, UI_VALID, ACKED_AT) VALUES (#{empNo}, #{institutionId}, #{roundSeq}, #{handledAt}, #{revNo}, #{bidCaseId}, #{stateCd}, #{verified}, #{screenId}, #{buttonId}, #{uiValid}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT ACKED_AT FROM PREP_NOBID_ACK WHERE EMP_NO = #{empNo} AND INSTITUTION_ID = #{institutionId} AND ROUND_SEQ = #{roundSeq} AND NOTICE_HANDLED_AT = #{handledAt}
